technical-summary: With remote-MoE helpers behind a 2/4-rank TP engine, decode-sized steps (at most 1 + max_spec rows) inject each helper's full-width row as a spare sorted row of HyperConn's fused ar_gather_hc_write (moe_mailbox_inject on the consumer rank, ew=1.0), so the fused gather + reducing write runs instead of add + standalone all-reduce + hc write; larger steps keep the unfused path. Fused steps never request the helper-row combine. Block and HyperConn share one fused/unfused predicate.
user-summary-candidate: Flash-Next tensor-parallel on the two 7900 XTX with remote experts: about 4% faster single-stream decode.
